defects.sourceQuote: 二龍交首嬉翔，解角而去。

fields.before: The beasts intertwined, sported in the air, dropped their horns, and flew away.
fields.after: The two dragons crossed their heads, sported and soared, shed their horns, and departed.
fields.reason: 二龍 must stay dragons; beasts drops the named creatures and 交首.
